name: Samoa NCD village patient followup report
notes:
Samoa NCD village screening patient follow up report - v2.24
This report generates a list of all patients that have had a had a 'Village Screening Form' completed with a calculated 10 year CVD risk level of >20%. The report includes details of where and when screening took place, and any subsequent clinic visits a patient may have had since their screening took place. Patients are listed chronologically by date of screening.
